svg.title: Afterglow icons, variant D (best practice, light 3D)
svg.text: Afterglow icons · variant D, best practice in light 3D
Variant A's grid, keylines, 2 px outline, radii, palette and metaphors, with one systematic depth pass: light from the upper left, one two-stop ramp per surface, a 1 px lit edge,
a slim lower-right extrusion on solid bodies (4 px deep, 2 px across at 48), a soft contact shadow, and a raised dusk plate for apps. Symbols only lift; stroke-only marks stay flat.
Depth halves to whole pixels at 24, drops to a 1 px lower-right edge at 16, and the eight hinted 16 px redraws keep A's crisp drawing plus that edge. No translucency, no reflections.
Construction · keylines at 2×, face raised 2 px, extrusion and shadow in the bottom margin
Ramps · lit stop, A's colour, low stop, side, lit edge
One light, upper left. Ramp 120°-ish, extrusion (2, 4), shadow offset 1 right. Plate: #1f2554 to #7a4562, side #4a2a44, lit edge #6e68a8.
Shadow: ink ellipse, ry 1.6, blur 1, 35 % under solids and plates, 22 % under symbols. Ink stays flat.
Proof strip · 48, 32, then 24 and 16 (hinted where drawn) on void, cream and dusk
16 px: A's hinted redraw, D's 16 profile (scaled master, depth cut to a 1 px lower-right step), and D's hinted redraw (A's pixels plus a 1 px side-tone edge on solids)
